negative_prompt: watermark, text signature, logo in corner, artist name, copyright notice, blurry, low resolution, bad anatomy, procedural 3D CGI grass, glossy digital video game render, real life photography with human artifacts, modern asphalt roads, modern powerlines, skyscrapers, cars, neon saturation
reconstruction_priority: Physical diorama clump-foliage and static grass turf — AI tends to hallucinate individual photorealistic CGI grass blades and generic procedural leaves
Tilt-shift miniature optical depth of field — AI often makes the entire image uniformly sharp or adds fake digital blur artifacts
Stream of hundreds of tiny handcrafted miniature sheep — AI often lumps small animals into blurry unrecognizable noise or draws full-sized realistic sheep
Warm sunny pastoral lighting and crisp dappled cast shadows — AI frequently washes out the directional afternoon sun into flat overcast ambient
